description: The solution catalog (the Successor Tech Lead Directive §13): every SOLUTION that can serve a durable concern, mapped through its neutral port + conformance contract — the provider-independence iron law (Zeck neutral capability port → conformance contract → provider adapter → provider/project; never Zeck domain → vendor SDK). Seeded from deploy/manifests/providers.json (the established truth) + the module ports; the evolution program's RESEARCH/COMPARE steps extend it.
ironLaw: vendor types, credentials, room/session ids and error strings never leave the adapter
the only optimization authority is the Execution Compiler — a solution never becomes a routing/optimization authority
a solution enters the catalog only with its port contract + conformance status recorded
the conformance contract is what a new provider codes against — never another provider's SDK shapes
